name: Meta Controller
reason: Referenced by core policy and authority constraints, so missing it leaves an external control dependency undefined. The dataset builder can still execute local gating logic, but controller enforcement remains incomplete.

name: learning_dataset
reason: This is the canonized target for eligible high-trust records. Without it, the core learning path cannot complete.

name: audit_log
reason: Audit routing is required across blocked, duplicate, and non-learning flows. Without this target, the canonized fail-closed and auditability paths cannot complete.

name: low_trust_storage
reason: It is a defined routing target for low-trust records, so missing it removes a major non-learning storage path. Core gating can still run, but one required destination is absent.

name: quarantine_storage
reason: It is a defined routing target for quarantined records, so missing it removes a major containment path. Core gating can still run, but one required destination is absent.
